record.question: Saint Durwasa __________ a curse on Shakuntala.
record.explanation: Answer C: called down. The idiom is “call down a curse on someone” (C). Independent check: “Call down a curse” means invoke or bring a curse upon someone; the collocation fits the sentence. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/call%20down.
